title: Thonny: The Beginner-Friendly Python Editor
description: Learn how to use Thonny, the free Python IDE built for beginners, to write, run, and debug your code with its step-by-step debugger.
summary: Are you a Python beginner looking for a tool that can support your learning? Every programmer needs a place to write their code.
takeaways: This article will discuss an awesome tool called Thonny that will enable you to start working with Python in a beginner-friendly environment.
